WBM R2D™

Requirements to Readiness

A structured path from brief to shortlist.

The proposed stage-gated model advances candidates only when the available information supports the next decision. The scope and depth of each step are defined for the role and engagement.

01Define

Role, criteria, location, timeline and presentation format.

02Source

Targeted search through relevant talent networks.

03Verify

Documentary, experience and reference checks as agreed.

04Assess

Role-specific technical, language and interview stages.

05Present

A clear shortlist supported by comparable candidate information.

06Prepare

Orientation, documentation support and readiness follow-up where authorized.

THE RESULT

Fewer unqualified profiles. Better visibility. A more efficient client evaluation.
